entities.summary: Arnold George Weinmeister was a Canadian professional football player who was a defensive tackle in the All-America Football Conference (AAFC), National Football League (NFL), and Western Interprovincial Football Union (WIFU). Renowned for his speed as a lineman, he went to four Pro Bowls in a six-year combined tenure in the AAFC and NFL. Weinmeister was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 1984, becoming the second Canadian to receive the honor; his six seasons is among the shortest for an inductee. He also played in the WIFU in Canada for two seasons.
